attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2906/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is not enumerated, so it is one folder. The display name takes the day because the corpus already keeps `twelve-soldier-martyrs-of-crete` on 12 August, who are a different company on a different day. The page's own link between these twelve and the hundred and fifty of the same day is hedged — «ίσως την εποχή των Εκατόν πενήντα Αγίων μαρτύρων στρατιωτών» — and the hedge is kept in the life. No year, no place, no hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
